# Google Forms

## Addresses

- Search: `https://docs.google.com/forms/u/${uid}/?q=${keyword}`
- Edit a form: `https://docs.google.com/forms/u/${uid}/d/${formId}/edit`
- New form: `https://docs.google.com/forms/u/${uid}/create`

## How it behaves

- Adding and moving items is quickest with shortcuts.
- A form has three main tabs: `Questions`, `Responses` and `Settings`.
- Focus often moves when you switch tabs or add an item, so snapshot again after either.

## Keys

The insert shortcuts are a sequence: keep `Cmd` held, press `i`, then the letter.

| Action | Keys |
| --- | --- |
| Insert a question | `Cmd` held, `i`, `i` |
| Insert a title and description | `Cmd` held, `i`, `h` |
| Insert an image | `Cmd` held, `i`, `p` |
| Insert a video | `Cmd` held, `i`, `v` |
| Insert a section | `Cmd` held, `i`, `b` |
| Move an item up / down | `Cmd+Shift+K` / `Cmd+Shift+J` |
| Delete an item | `Option+Shift+D` |
| Duplicate an item | `Cmd+Shift+D` |
| Next / previous control | `Tab` / `Shift+Tab` |
| Use the focused control | `Enter` |
| Tick a checkbox or radio | `Space` |
| Delete selected content | `Delete` or `Backspace` |
